_README: Gold-reference fact/junk anchors for the fetch_url extraction harness. Curated by 4 fable5 adversaries (2026-07-11) from raw-byte fetches of each page, NOT from the tool's own output. 'facts' = distinctive substrings that MUST appear in extracted content (whitespace/case-normalized). 'junk' = boilerplate substrings that MUST NOT appear (nav/sidebar/author-box/consent). 'title_contains' = expected title substring. Scoring: fact_recall = matched_facts / total_facts; junk_ratio = matched_junk / total_junk. Bar: recall >= 0.90 and junk == 0.
